description: The image shows a young man standing on a white scale in a living room. He is wearing a blue plaid button-down shirt and blue jeans. He has short dark hair and is looking off to the side with a serious expression on his face. In the background, there are four people sitting on a beige couch, two men and two women, and a coffee table with red cups and water bottles. There is also a plant in the corner of the room.
